lines.en: I trot across the red earth.
My legs are thin, but quick.
Sand flies from under my claws.
I follow behind my companions.
I run a circle around a stone.
My neck bobs as I run.
I walk on across the red soil.
There's soil on my claws.
My short steps are quick.
I run past a clump of dry grass.
I stop when I hear a sound.
I run back into the group.
I'm small and see things low.
I run on, weaving.
I crouch on top of a stone.
The sand is hot under the sun.
My forelimbs are shorter than my hind legs.
I'm keeping an eye on things.
The wind stirs the feathers on my tail.
I scratched at the soil.
My companions are foraging over there.
I raise my head toward the sun.
I rest my chin on the soil.
I'm small; I'm easy to overlook.
I turn slowly through half a circle.
I hear something in the distance.
You're above me, and very big.
I look up and back off a little.
I'm really quite small.
It's all red earth at your feet.
A small patch of ground lies between us.
One of your steps takes five of mine.
I edge over to one side.
I'd guess you're not here for grass.
I've shrunk down beside a stone.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土，把我的爪磨钝。
lines.en: Badlands clay dulls my claws.
I lift a foot and test which way.
I'm decent over a short distance.
I scrambled up and ran.
I am small, but I can still get up.
I scream and dive into the red earth gully.
I ducked behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，沙从羽毛里掉。
lines.en: I shake and sand falls out of my feathers.
I don't much dare to move.
I can still run.
Two hits and I can still run.
Is that something edible?
I only eat insects and small things.
That bit in your hand is too small.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子闻了闻那只手。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to sniff that hand.
This smell is interesting.
I'll look again before deciding.
You're holding it perfectly still.
I gave two steps of ground.
That's nowhere near enough to share.
One of your steps shoved me aside.
I got sand all over me.
I'm small; I can't move you.
Your boot stands well above me.
I darted behind a stone.

lines.zh: 你的脚一挪，我贴地窜开。
lines.en: Your foot shifts and I dart away along the ground.
I shook the sand off.
I'll run further off.
Are you in this group too?
We often run together.
Your legs are longer than mine.
Answer when I call.
There's room for us on the red earth.
Let's look for insects together.
Don't scatter too far, everyone.
Stay behind me and it's fine.
Let's rest a while together.
This will do for now.
I snatched up a small bug.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫在我爪间挣扎。
lines.en: A beetle struggles between my claws.
I ran off with it in my teeth.
A little stone — not much use.
You dropped this on the red earth.
I put my nose down to sniff.
I dropped it.
It rolled between my claws.
There's soil all over it.
I stop and look at you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，随时要溜。
lines.en: I watch your boots, ready to bolt.
I crouch, ready to run.
I'm backing toward the stones.
I'm fast on red earth.
I mean to outrun you.
I'm watching where your feet land.
I'm about to break to the side.
I scrabble my claws in the sand.
You can't turn that quickly.
I'll run past that heap of stones.
Come chase me again.
I run circles around the stones.
Red dust rises under my feet.
You can't keep up with me.
I'm small — hard to keep in sight.
Your panting is right behind me.
That dry grass will block your view.
I've circled back.
I'm watching your footsteps.
You're still some way off.
I can go a little faster yet.
My prints in the sand are shallow.
I've slipped into a crack.
You won't find me here.
Do you want another run?
I won't go far.
My claws raked you once.
You didn't expect me to charge.
I bit and ran off.

lines.zh: 小身子的力气，也就这样。
lines.en: Small body, small strength.
A kick sent me rolling.
I've come around the other side.
You're bending down to grab me.
I slipped between your fingers.
I've got hold of your trouser leg.
It took two shakes to free it.
I've jumped onto a stone.
This hardly counts as a wound.
I'm already far off.
I won't try that again.
I dart out from behind the stones.
Heat shimmers off the red earth.
I'm with a few companions.
The ground is all cracked earth.
I look up at the badlands.
The wind ruffles my tail feathers.
I start hunting for insects.
There's a stir in the distance.
I stretch my hind legs.
I run two steps that way.
The soil is loose, good for running.
I heard a footstep.
I stop and crouch low.
I don't plan to go over.
I've ducked back into the stones.
The heat singed my feathers.
I hit the ground and my claws skidded.
Water swallowed me whole.

lines.zh: 箭风扫过羽毛，我躲进石缝。
lines.en: The arrow's wind ruffles my feathers; I duck into a crevice.
Hunger has drained my legs.
The thunder made me leap up.
The emptiness below is unnerving.
